title: 3. Dive to the photon orbit and get out
notes: You are on a zoom-whirl orbit: you will whip around the hole close to the photon orbit (where light circles it, 2.35 M prograde for a = 0.5) and then fall in. The map's predicted path (dashed) is red when it ends in the hole. Get out: point away from the hole (5) and hold Shift for the main engine, before it is too late.
